questions.question: What does this unit mainly help you practise: purpose and contrast?
Working on purpose and contrast can improve both written and spoken English.

Understanding context is important when choosing the correct form in English.
Which activity can reinforce purpose and contrast?
Good English learning also involves noticing mistakes and correcting them.
At lycée level, why is purpose and contrast useful?
choices: It helps communicate clearly and precisely
It avoids any need for practice
It is only useful in mathematics
